items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: Interviewer mentions Bix Beiderbecke as a stylistic comparison; Interviewee does not confirm personal interaction or specific influence, stating style 'came to me'.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's what I understood too.

Harry, your style is different from almost any other jazz clarinet player in the world. Completely different from your brother's style. And completely different from any other style I've ever had. It's a very lyrical and very melodic and a very creative style in the category of Bix Beiderback. I'm not saying that you copied from Bix Beiderback, but you know what I mean? Bix had a very lyrical style and each one of his notes counted. Can you put your finger on anybody who inspired you in your style? Or was it just…
I really can't, John. I just... I don't know. I guess it's just a style that came to me. As I said before, Larry was very creative. And maybe it's sort of ran the family, by the way I see.
